title: Install Node.js on Windows
summary: Short article with the steps to install the LTS release of Node.js on Windows, including the required restart, and to confirm the install in Hyper.

concepts.heading: Install steps (Windows)
points: Get the Windows installer from nodejs.org and choose the LTS build (left-hand option on the download page).
Accept the licence, click Next through the screens and keep the default settings.
Restart the PC afterwards. Node commands will not work in the terminal until after a reboot.
Open Hyper and run node --version to confirm; the installed version number should appear.

concepts.heading: (Extra) Useful checks
points: (Extra) Keep the installer's default option that adds Node to PATH; without it the node command is not recognised.
(Extra) npm comes bundled with Node; npm --version confirms it is ready for the NPM lessons later in the section.

code_examples.caption: Confirm the install (in Hyper / Git Bash)

pitfalls: Skipping the restart, then getting 'node is not recognized' in the terminal.
Picking the Current release instead of LTS.
